Stellendetails

Für unsere Standorte Mainz oder Berlin suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt für bis zu 20 Wochenstunden und zunächst befristet eine*n Werkstudent*in Data Analytics (m/w/d).


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du verarbeitest, analysierst und visualisierst Daten aus den Bereichen Social Media, TV und Streaming
  • Du unterstützt bei der Erstellung und Automatisierung von regelmäßigen Reports
  • Du recherchierst zu Themen wie Datenvisualisierung, Dashboarding-Tools oder Markt- und Metrikbeobachtung im Bereich Social Media und Streaming
  • Du unterstützt bei der Konzeptionierung und Analyse des Trackings unserer digitalen Produkte (Web und App)
  • Du unterstützt bei der Umsetzung und Konzeption von Datapipelines für die Nutzung strukturierter und unstrukturierter Daten auf Basis von Datenverarbeitungssystemen aus dem Medienumfeld und der Webanalyse


Dein Profil

  • Du absolvierst derzeit ein Bachelor- oder Masterstudium in Medienwissenschaften, Soziologie, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Statistik oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang mit quantitativer Ausrichtung
  • Du hast Kenntnisse und eine Affinität zu statistischen Verfahren und datengetriebenen analytischen Methoden
  • Du verfügst idealerweise über erste praktische Erfahrungen im Bereich der Datenvisualisierung
  • Du kannst komplexe Problemstellungen aufnehmen und arbeitest zusammen mit dem Team an Lösungen
  • Du kannst dich sehr gut selbst strukturieren und deine Arbeit eigenständig priorisieren
  • Du bringt eine Leidenschaft für Medien mit
  • Du hast idealerweise erste Erfahrungen in einer oder mehreren Programmiersprachen wie z. B. Python, Go, Scala, etc. oder mit Cloud-Infrastrukturen (z. B. GCP, AWS, Azure)
  • Du besitzt vorzugsweise erste Erfahrungen in den Bereichen Web Tracking (z. B. Google Analytics oder Matomo), Design/Gestaltung oder Dashboarding-Tools (z. B. Power BI, Tableau)
  • Du bist versiert im Umgang mit den gängigen MS Office-Anwendungen, insbesondere Excel und PowerPoint
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift


Unser Angebot an dich

Bei uns erwartet dich ein abwechslungsreiches Aufgabengebiet mit Gestaltungsspielraum für eigenverantwortliches Handeln. Zusammen mit dem motivierten und engagierten Team arbeitest du an spannenden Aufgaben und abwechslungsreichen Themen. Unsere Kultur ist geprägt von einem offenen Austausch, einem entspannten, aber professionellen Miteinander und flachen Hierarchien. Hier erwartet dich ein attraktiver und moderner, ergonomischer Arbeitsplatz sowie eine grüne Büroumgebung. Damit du Studium-, Arbeits- und Privatleben bestmöglich kombinieren kannst, besteht nach Absprache mit deiner Führungskraft die Möglichkeit zur flexiblen Arbeitszeitgestaltung und Mobile Office. Neben Flexibilität, netten Kolleg*innen und einladenden Büros kannst du dich außerdem auf regelmäßige Firmenevents und vieles mehr freuen.


Kontakt

Da sich unser Content an eine vielseitige Gesellschaft richtet, möchten wir auch in unseren Teams die gesellschaftliche Vielfalt repräsentieren. Auch, wenn du unserem Anforderungsprofil nicht zu 100% entsprichst, freuen wir uns darauf, dich durch deinen Lebenslauf, Zeugnisse, Arbeitsproben und ein Motivationsschreiben kennenzulernen. As Head of Supply Chain, you own every part of how physical goods reach our fleet and our riders, from the purchase order to the shelf to the courier's bike. You report to our Director of Operations and work directly with Hardware, Finance, Software and our country teams. In particular you will:

  • Oversee our assembly & refurbishment activities: Manage our assembly and refurbishment partners, own the bills of material for everything we build from purchased components as well as internal refurbishment within our locations.
  • Own the systems, not just the process: Take full responsibility for our ERP and warehouse management setup for all supply chain topics, from data model and master data through to daily execution – you will be the business owner to our software team and guide implementation.
  • Professionalize the structure: Design and implement the processes, controls and physical setup our growing operation needs, and then get your hands dirty making them real and ensuring your organization internalizes them.

  • Drive the agenda across teams: Set priorities, align Hardware, Finance and Tech behind them, and hold the line when it matters. 
  • Partner with the larger organization and understand your impact on them: All you do, you do with the end goal in mind to become the best friend of our Local and Country Operations and Sales teams, who all depend on your fulfillment excellence to grow and maintain their businesses.

  • 10+ years of relevant professional experience, of which at least 5 in a managerial supply chain or operations role.

Nice to have:

  • Background in bike, scooter, mobility or another hardware-heavy industry where physical goods move between internal as well as external locations.
  • German or Dutch

  • Exciting industry: You will work in the dynamic world of mobility, which is a constantly evolving sector.
  • Real impact: Your work improves the lives of many bike couriers.
  • Take on immediate responsibility: Start making a difference right away and implement your own ideas. Boredom? Not a chance!

  • International team & Strong network: Work alongside motivated colleagues from all over the world. Teamwork is very important to us.
  • Fair conditions: We offer a stable employment with attractive salary, €50 HRmony voucher, a company e-bike, modern equipment and 28 days' holiday a year.


Diversity

At CYCLE, we believe diversity makes us stronger. No matter who you are, where you're from, or what makes you unique, you're welcome here.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Your mission

Bookboost is the Hospitality Engagement Platform that empowers hotels to understand and engage their guests like never before. We unify guest data, automate personalised communication, and deliver experiences that drive revenue, loyalty, and operational excellence.

We have customers across more than 20 countries and a platform that wins on depth. We're now looking for a Full Stack Engineer to help us build the next stage of it.

Tech stack: Angular | TypeScript | Node.js | Cloudflare Workers | AWS | PostgreSQL | Terraform


Your profile

As a Full Stack Engineer you build and maintain the systems behind our platform: real-time data processing, the APIs that hold it together, and the experience our customers use every day.

The job is shifting from writing syntax to designing systems. We want engineers who are architects: people who define the right abstractions, shape the right interfaces, and make decisions that hold up six months later. Agents write a growing share of the code. Your value is in orchestrating intent, context and execution.

You would be joining a small engineering team with real latitude on technical direction. This is not a seat implementing someone else's design. If you want to be handed tickets and left alone, this is not that job. If you want a say in how the platform is built, it is a good one.

What you'll own and deliver

  • Scalable, high-performance applications across the stack
  • Frontend applications in Angular, with genuine attention to responsiveness and user experience
  • APIs designed with the rest of the team, focused on event-driven architecture and real-time data
  • Edge computing work using Cloudflare Workers, improving performance and deployment efficiency
  • Migration of services to edge runtimes, improving scalability and reducing latency
  • Architectural decisions that outlive the tickets that prompted them
  • Cross-functional work with design, product and Operations on what customers actually need
What makes you a great fit?
  • Full stack depth: 4+ years with modern frontend and backend technologies, and production systems you have owned rather than contributed to
  • Backend: strong in Node.js or another JavaScript runtime, and TypeScript. PHP and Laravel are a plus, not a requirement.
  • Data: relational databases, particularly PostgreSQL, including schema design and query optimisation
  • Frontend: modern frameworks, particularly Angular
  • Edge: familiarity with Cloudflare Workers and services such as Durable Objects, KV and Workflows, or other edge runtimes
  • Cloud: understanding of cloud architecture, particularly AWS
  • AI fluency: our engineering team runs on an AI-native stack. You write code and documentation with AI tools and can talk concretely about how that has changed the way you work. This is a genuine requirement, not a bonus line.
  • Systems thinking: root cause over band-aids, patterns over one-offs. You would rather fix the shape of a problem than patch it again.
  • Craft: you care about reliability, observability, testability and documentation
  • Language: fluent English. Swedish is not required.
What's in it for you?
  • Remote and flexible working, from home or one of our hubs
  • Real influence over technical direction at a company still deciding
  • An engineering team building new ways of working with AI rather than bolting it on
  • An environment that values your judgement, with real room for impact
  • Regular team events and socials


Why us?

Bookboost gives hotel groups ownership of their guest relationships. We unify guest data across the PMS, booking engine and every communication channel, then orchestrate the guest journey pre-stay, in-stay and post-stay. Based in Malmö, Sweden, with hubs in Amsterdam and Barcelona, we work in a hybrid, remote-friendly way. Diversity and innovation go hand in hand, and we are committed to an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

Everyone is welcome at Bookboost
We value individuality and creativity, and we are building a team that reflects the world we serve. If you are passionate about making a difference, apply even if you do not meet every criterion.

Ready to join us?
Send us your application today. We interview on a rolling basis, so apply early.
